_doc: Reference deployments + cited industry research. Per docs/A2Z_LIVING_DOCS_PLAN.md Part 3 Rule 8, bank logos appear only with signed reference agreements; external case studies are clearly labelled as 'cited industry research', not A2Z deployments.

a2z_reference_deployments.scope: A2Z Blueprint pilot — internal performance management + pipeline + CRM workflows
a2z_reference_deployments.honest_disclaimer: Ecobank Kenya is the design partner for the A2Z Blueprint local instance. This is a development context, not a production deployment with measured outcomes. Production reference status requires a separate signed agreement.

cited_industry_research._label: EXTERNAL CITATION — NOT AN A2Z CUSTOMER
cited_industry_research.claim: 99.2% repayment rate on alternative-credit-scoring loans to thin-file SME borrowers
cited_industry_research.relevance_to_a2z: Validates the alternative-credit-scoring approach the A2Z engine implements at design level (utils/alternative_credit_scoring.py).
cited_industry_research.honest_disclaimer: Zanifu is a separate Kenyan fintech, not an A2Z customer. The 99.2% figure is their published outcome on their own portfolio. A2Z's engine implements the same alternative-credit-scoring pattern but no comparable A2Z deployment results exist yet.

cited_industry_research._label: EXTERNAL CITATION — NOT AN A2Z CUSTOMER
cited_industry_research.claim: Working capital optimization across supplier networks; addressable opportunity in Africa estimated at $25-30B by industry analysts
cited_industry_research.relevance_to_a2z: The value-chain financing module (utils/value_chain_financing.py, designed) addresses this market opportunity.
cited_industry_research.honest_disclaimer: C2FO is a global working-capital fintech, not an A2Z customer. The $25-30B estimate is from public C2FO research. A2Z's value-chain module is designed but not yet a wired feature; production deployment is roadmap.

honest_scope: A2Z does not currently have any signed production-reference deployments with measurable outcomes.
Numbers like '99.2% repayment' or '$25-30B opportunity' come from external companies' published research, not from A2Z deployments. They appear only in 'Cited industry research' sections.
Bank logos and named-customer testimonials require signed reference agreements; the magazine-generator must check this flag before rendering.
The Ecobank Kenya design-partner relationship is for product development; it is not represented as a customer success story in published collateral.
Future production deployments with measurable outcomes will be added here as 'a2z_reference_deployments' entries with may_appear_in_collateral: true.
